title: CardCorpus printed text of a set
description: What each card of a set prints, word for word: names, levels, attacks, abilities, trainer and energy text, rule boxes and rule lines, weakness and resistance as printed, and flavor text. English cards are read off their pictures; other languages' text comes from official and other card lists and is not yet checked against the cards (`checked`: `source`). It is the print, not how the card plays now: official errata are in the play files (plays/{id}.json). A card we have no text for is not listed. text/{set}.json, by the set's id (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#printed-text).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `set`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

cardCount.description: How many cards are listed: the length of `cards`.

cards.description: Its cards whose text is read, in the set file's order.

items.description: A card and what it prints.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `card`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

id.description: The card's id, unique in its set.

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

number.description: A copy of the target's own `number`. Its number as printed ("4/102", "SWSH001"), and that number without its set total.

printed.description: The number as printed, where the card prints one.

short.description: The number without its set total: "4" of "4/102", and the whole number where it prints no total ("SWSH001"). What a tile shows and a sort reads.

text.description: What the card prints, as printed (case and punctuation kept, italics dropped). Energy symbols are type names: in costs and `types` as `Lightning`, `Colorless`; inside text in braces, `{Darkness}`.

name.description: The name as printed, with its suffix (`ex`, `EX`, `GX`, `V`, `LV.X`, `δ`); empty for a basic Energy that prints only ENERGY and its symbol.

level.description: A printed level, such as 42 for LV.42; null where none is printed.

subtype.description: The category of a trainer or energy, in English in every language: `Item`, `Supporter`, `Stadium`, `Pokémon Tool`, `Trainer`, `Basic Energy`, `Special Energy`, …

stage.description: A Pokémon's stage, in English in every language: `Basic`, `Stage 1`, `Stage 2`, `BREAK`, `VMAX`, …

types.description: The type symbols printed beside the HP.

markers.description: Printed labels that are neither text nor stage: `Future`, `Ancient`, `Tera`, `Rapid Strike`, `Prism Star`, `ACE SPEC`, `Team Plasma`, …

abilities.description: Abilities, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, Pokémon Powers, Ancient Traits and the like, in printed order.

label.description: Its printed label: `Ability`, `Poké-Power`, `Poké-Body`, `Pokémon Power`, `Ancient Trait`, `VSTAR Power`, …
`GX` or `VSTAR` for a GX attack or VSTAR Power attack, else null; the name leaves the logo out.

cost.description: Its Energy cost, one type a symbol; empty for a free attack.

damage.description: Damage as printed (`30`, `30+`, `20×`), empty where none.

effect.description: A trainer's or energy's text, one string a printed paragraph.

rules.description: Rule boxes and rule lines as printed (the Pokémon ex rule, You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn., …).

label.description: Its printed label, where it has one.

value.description: The value as printed (`×2`, `+20`); empty where the card prints only the type.
The value as printed (`-30`); empty where none is printed.

retreat.description: How many retreat symbols are printed.

checked.description: How the text is known: `agreed`, a blind read of the picture matches the text other transcriptions give on every part; `judged`, they differed and each difference was settled by a closer look at the picture; `picture`, only the picture read gives it; `source`, a card list gives it and it is not yet checked against the card (languages other than English).

unsure.description: Parts a closer look could not settle; `text` keeps the read.
